title: Timed writing tasks (25 minutes)
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 45 (Pupil PDF worksheet: timed writing tasks)
intro: Lesson 45. Our own tasks. Plan for 3 minutes, write, and leave 4 minutes to check.

blocks.h: Group A: 4AA1 Paper 2 style (choose one, 25 marks)

questions.q: رِسَالَةٌ إِلَى صَدِيقٍ: Write a letter to a friend about a journey you made last year: where, how you travelled, what you saw, your feelings, and where you will go next.
questions.a: All bullets covered; three time frames; accurate endings and agreement; varied connectives

questions.q: مَقَالَةٌ: Write an article for the school magazine: 'Is technology good for young people?' Give both sides and your opinion.
questions.a: Balanced arguments, a justified conclusion, formal register

questions.q: Write about 90 words about your free time: what you do, what you did last weekend, what you will do in the holidays, and your opinion.
questions.a: Every bullet covered; three time frames; opinions with reasons

questions.q: Translate into Arabic: 'I live in London with my family. Last year I visited my grandparents and next year I will go to Makkah.'
questions.a: أَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ مَعَ عَائِلَتِي. زُرْتُ جَدِّي وَجَدَّتِي فِي السَّنَةِ المَاضِيَةِ، وَسَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فِي السَّنَةِ القَادِمَةِ.
